tutorial.goal.shootDown: Destroy every attacking drone and robot
tutorial.hint.build: Select your dozer, pick the building in the command bar and click a free spot near your base.
tutorial.hint.train: Select the {producer} and pick the unit in the command bar.
tutorial.hint.clear: The enemy waits {direction} of your base. Drag a box around your units, click the ground to move there, then click an enemy to attack it.
tutorial.hint.uaFpv: An FPV team carries radio-guided racing drones and launches them on its own at enemies in range; they are deadly against tanks. Train one at the Barracks.
tutorial.hint.uaBabaYaga: The Baba Yaga is a heavy bomber drone from the Drone workshop. Order it to attack and it flies over the target and drops its bombs, then returns to the workshop to reload. Rifle fire can shoot it down.
tutorial.hint.uaDroneStrike: The enemy waits east of your base. Walk the FPV team towards the tank: it launches its drones by itself. Send the Baba Yaga at the riflemen by clicking them.
tutorial.hint.uaSting: Russia attacks with Shahed drones (Geran-2). A Sting nest launches interceptor drones at them by itself, but only at low flyers. Build one with your dozer near the power plant.
tutorial.hint.uaGepard: The Gepard is a mobile anti-air gun from the Vehicle factory. It shoots down drones and aircraft at short range. Park it next to the power plant.
tutorial.hint.uaShootDown: Shaheds are flying at your power plant! The Sting nest and the Gepard fire on their own; keep them close to the plant.
tutorial.hint.ruMolniya: A Molniya crew launches drones guided by a fibre-optic cable: no jammer can stop them, but they only reach close targets. Train one at the Barracks.
tutorial.hint.ruGeran: The Geran-2 (Shahed) is a cheap one-way attack drone built at the Geran launch site. It waits on its rail until you give it a target.
tutorial.hint.ruDroneStrike: The enemy outpost is west of your base. Select a Geran and click the enemy power plant: it flies there and explodes. Walk the Molniya crew towards the enemy vehicle.
tutorial.hint.ruPantsir: Ukraine attacks with bomber drones and robots. The Pantsir is a mobile anti-air missile system from the Vehicle factory that shoots down anything flying. Build one.
tutorial.hint.ruPole: The Pole-21 is an unarmed jammer from the Vehicle factory: radio-guided drones fall and radio-guided robots freeze inside its range. Build one.
tutorial.hint.ruShootDown: Ukrainian bombers and robots are heading for your power plant! Park the Pantsir and the Pole-21 next to it, then finish the frozen robots with your riflemen.

saves.vehicle-deaths.name: Vehicle deaths

saves.infantry-vs-armor.name: Infantry vs armor

saves.weapon-impacts.name: Weapon impacts

saves.tank-friendly-fire.name: Tank friendly fire
saves.tank-friendly-fire.description: A Leopard force-fires at a point while its own Kozak scout drives into it: the shell lands on the friendly scout and hurts it.
saves.crater-crossing.name: Crater crossing
saves.crater-crossing.description: A HIMARS salvo digs a crater under a Leopard that has just stopped, so the hull drops and tilts with the relief.
saves.rpg-ambush.name: RPG ambush
saves.rpg-ambush.description: RPG gunners on both sides of the road as four Bradleys drive past.
saves.artillery-range.name: Artillery range
saves.artillery-range.description: HIMARS and TOS-1A fire at enemy buildings from long range, guided by scouts.
saves.force-fire-demo.name: Force fire
saves.force-fire-demo.description: Select the HIMARS and click the spotted Russian truck to give it an attack order.
saves.defenses.name: Defenses
saves.defenses.description: Stugna-P and Kornet emplacements against vehicles driving into range.

saves.economy.name: Economy

saves.production.name: Production

saves.selling.name: Sell buildings
saves.selling.description: Queue units, then select a complete building and sell it for half its cost plus a full queue refund.
saves.building-repair.name: Building repair
saves.building-repair.description: Select the two dozers and click the damaged power plant or barracks; repair is free and does not stack.
saves.infantry-healing.name: Infantry healing
saves.infantry-healing.description: Select the damaged riflemen and click your barracks: healing is free, takes two seconds and production continues; they walk out whole.
saves.vehicle-repair.name: Vehicle repair
saves.vehicle-repair.description: Select a damaged vehicle and click its factory: free five-second repair, one vehicle at a time.
saves.construction.name: Construction
saves.construction.description: Barracks and factories at 0, 30, 60 and 100 % built.
saves.damaged-base.name: Damaged buildings
saves.damaged-base.description: Every building type at 100, 75, 50, 25 and 10 % HP.
saves.pathfinding-river.name: River crossing
saves.pathfinding-river.description: Ten units ordered across the river, away from the fords.
saves.tank-through-group.name: Tank through a parked group
saves.tank-through-group.description: One tank ordered across a packed block of idle tanks, which make way for it.
saves.crowd.name: Crowd
saves.crowd.description: Sixty units per side advancing through each other.
saves.gore.name: Gore
saves.gore.description: Twenty riflemen per side at close range; toggle gore with G.
saves.victory-near.name: Victory
saves.victory-near.description: The last Russian building at 5 % HP under attack.
saves.ai-attack.name: AI attack
saves.ai-attack.description: A small Ukrainian base against the russia-rush AI with 40000 credits.
saves.run-over.name: Run over
saves.run-over.description: A Leopard and a supply truck drive through Russian riflemen: the tank crushes them, the truck shoves them aside.
saves.hills-and-cliffs.name: Hills and cliffs
saves.hills-and-cliffs.description: Ukrainian armour climbs the ramp of a plateau on First Line; Russian tanks wait under its cliffs.
saves.demo-coast.name: Demo coast
saves.demo-coast.description: A sea coast with a harbour (pier, quays, cranes, warehouses, containers, boats, buoys, lighthouses), a river with a ford and a lake; two tanks per side.
saves.demo-bridges.name: Demo bridges
saves.demo-bridges.description: A deep river with a road bridge, a wooden bridge and a stone arch, roads leading to each; tanks and infantry of both sides wait at the approaches: order them across.
saves.environment-destruction.name: Environment destruction
saves.environment-destruction.descriptio: A tank flattens bushes and fences, a shell sets a pine grove on fire, two buildings collapse into rubble and a wooden bridge breaks.
saves.environment-cover.name: Environment cover
saves.environment-cover.description: Riflemen on a plateau shoot at enemies below, farther than flat ground allows: behind a stone wall, beside a pine stand and in the open. Cover cuts the damage they take.
saves.infantry-transport.name: Infantry transport
saves.infantry-transport.description: Riflemen board a Bradley and a Kozak. Left click your own vehicle with infantry selected to board it, and press Unload to let them out one by one. Kozak riders shoot from the vehicle.
saves.bridge-repair.name: Bridge repair
saves.bridge-repair.description: A broken and a damaged bridge. Riflemen and dozers repair them; left click a damaged bridge with workers selected. More workers finish faster, and the broken bridge reopens.
saves.trench-digging.name: Trench digging
saves.trench-digging.description: Riflemen and a dozer dig two trenches. Select infantry, press Dig trench, then click the ground to dig one or drag a line to dig a whole trench line; a finished trench halves the damage its soldiers take.
saves.trench-network.name: Trench network
saves.trench-network.description: A finished trench network: a straight line, a corner and a diagonal joined into one channel, with covered shelters, plus a half-dug and a barely started piece. Select the dozer or riflemen and click a construction mark to dig on, or press Dig trench and draw a line across the network.
saves.trench-assault.name: Trench assault
saves.trench-assault.description: A Ukrainian squad holds a trench line with a covered shelter piece; a Russian squad walks into the far end of the same line. They close in piece by piece and fight with pistols while a Russian thermobaric launcher wears the trench down: the sheltered soldiers take nothing, the others take the splash.
saves.port-supply.name: Port supply
saves.port-supply.description: Supply trucks load at the harbour's cargo yard, which never runs out but loads slowly, and at an ordinary supply depot that empties.
saves.amphibious-crossing.name: Amphibious crossing
saves.amphibious-crossing.description: Russian BMP-2s and a BRDM-2 swim straight across the river while a T-72 drives round by a bridge. Right click the far bank to try it.
saves.town-drones.name: Drones over the city
saves.town-drones.description: The Ukrainian base stands in the middle of its city. A wave of Geran drones dives one by one into the apartment block next to it: every hit explodes and the block crumbles until it collapses.
saves.air-war.name: Air war
saves.air-war.description: Two Su-34 jets and a wave of Geran drones strike a Ukrainian base defended by a Sting nest, a Patriot and a Gepard. Watch the interceptors rise.
saves.robots-vs-jammer.name: Robots against a jammer
saves.robots-vs-jammer.description: Ukrainian robots and FPV drones advance on a Pole-21 jammer and stop dead inside its circle, while a Russian crew's fibre-guided Molniya drones fly through it.
saves.deep-strike.name: Deep strike
saves.deep-strike.description: A Flamingo and a Storm Shadow leave a Ukrainian missile site for a Russian base. The Pantsir shoots the Flamingo down; the stealthy Storm Shadow slips past.

saves.environment-garrison.name: Environment garrison
saves.environment-garrison.description: Riflemen garrison an apartment block and fire from its windows with more range and damage; another squad can garrison a house, and a tank shells the east block the enemy holds.
saves.landscape-lab.name: Landscape lab
saves.landscape-lab.description: A map with ground patches, a road, a river with a ford, a lake, a sea strip, pines and houses; two tanks per side.
saves.demo-town.name: Demo town
saves.demo-town.description: A small town: main street of shops and houses, apartment blocks, church square, gas station, factory district, the same buildings intact, damaged, wrecked and abandoned, and an abandoned quarter.
saves.demo-forest.name: Demo forest
saves.demo-forest.description: Every tree, bush and hedge type: a catalogue of variants, a forest edge, groves, a palm beach, a burnt grove and hedgerows; two tanks per side.
saves.demo-ground.name: Ground and roads
saves.demo-ground.description: Every ground material side by side, an asphalt crossroads, dirt tracks, a muddy field, a concrete plaza, rocks and sand; two tanks per side.
saves.audio-fight.name: Audio fight
saves.audio-fight.description: A close-range combined-arms fight between Ukrainian and Russian forces to test weapons, voices, impacts, explosions and EVA.
saves.river-port.name: River port
saves.river-port.description: The default map seen from above: a river into the sea with a road bridge, a ford, a wooden bridge and a stone arch, a harbour per side, forests, hills and plateaus with rich depots.

campaign.hint.survive: Hold your ground: keep your buildings standing until the clock runs out.
campaign.hint.victory: Finish the job: hunt down every enemy building on the map.
campaign.ua.aim: Survive the invasion, take the war back to Russia and bring down Putin.
campaign.ru.aim: Win the war in Ukraine and bring every republic of the old Union back under Moscow.
campaign.ua.01.title: Hostomel
campaign.ua.01.when: 24 February 2022 · Antonov Airport, Hostomel, north-west of Kyiv
campaign.ua.01.video: Black screen. An air-raid siren winds up. 05:00: the first cruise missiles light up the Kyiv skyline. Cut to dawn over the Kyiv Reservoir: thirty helicopters, Ka-52 gunships and Mi-8 transports, skim the water so low their rotors throw spray. A National Guard conscript at the Antonov Airport fence looks up, drops his tea and runs for a Stinger. A Mi-8 trails smoke into the reeds. Inside a hangar, the giant An-225 Mriya sits in the dark. Russian paratroopers rappel onto the runway. Title: MODERN CONQUEST: RED LINE — UKRAINE.
campaign.ua.01.briefing: Commander, Russian airborne troops (VDV) have landed by helicopter at the Antonov cargo airport in Hostomel, 25 km from the government quarter. Their plan is simple: hold the runway for a few hours so that a stream of Il-76 transports can fly in thousands more paratroopers and a direct road to Kyiv. The 4th Rapid Reaction Brigade of the National Guard is fighting back with what it has. Hold the airfield until our reinforcements arrive, then wipe out their landing zone. Every hour we deny them the runway, the airlift stays in the air.
campaign.ua.01.hint.hold: VDV paratroopers and BMDs are heading for your headquarters. Keep your riflemen and Stugna teams together near the HQ and train more at the Barracks.
campaign.ua.01.hint.lz: Reinforcements are here. The landing zone is just east of the airfield: hit the command post and the barracks before the next wave lands.
campaign.ua.02.title: The Irpin Line
campaign.ua.02.when: Late February – March 2022 · Irpin river and the road from Ivankiv
campaign.ua.02.video: Satellite footage: a grey column of trucks and armour 60 km long, frozen on the road north of Kyiv. Night. In a forest clearing, volunteers from the Aerorozvidka drone unit, programmers and hobbyists a week ago, tape grenades under commercial quadcopters by the light of their phones. Thermal camera: a fuel truck at the head of the column bursts into flame, and the column cannot move. Cut to Irpin: the road bridge collapses into the river in a column of smoke; refugees cross on planks beneath its broken spans, carrying children and cats.
campaign.ua.02.briefing: The bridge at Irpin is down, blown up by our own sappers to stop their tanks. On the far bank a Russian supply convoy is stuck, short of fuel and spare tyres, and their spearhead is starving. Aerorozvidka has shown how: small drones at night, aimed at the fuel and ammunition trucks. Train FPV teams, cut the convoy to pieces, then clear their bridgehead. Without fuel, the march on Kyiv dies in the mud.
campaign.ua.02.hint.fpv: FPV teams carry radio-guided drones; train them at the Barracks. They launch on their own at anything in range.
campaign.ua.02.goal.convoy: Destroy the four supply trucks of the convoy
campaign.ua.02.hint.convoy: The convoy waits on the east bank, south of the bridges. Walk the FPV teams to the river: their drones fly over the water.
campaign.ua.03.title: The Flagship
campaign.ua.03.video: Spring in the north: Russian columns are pulling back from Kyiv. In Bucha, journalists walk down Yablunska Street and stop filming. Cut to a truck in a vineyard near Odesa, its launch tubes rising. A Bayraktar TB2 circles on the horizon, drawing the radar of the cruiser Moskva, flagship of the Black Sea Fleet. Two Neptune missiles skim the waves. Night-vision: the cruiser lists, burning. The next morning, a grainy photo of the ship smoking and tilted. Moscow says an ammunition fire. The fleet's flagship is on the seabed.
campaign.ua.03.briefing: The cruiser Moskva covers the whole western Black Sea with her air-defence radars and threatens Odesa with a landing. She is protected by a coastal air-defence screen and directed from the fleet command post on the shore. Build a missile site, blind the radar screen, then destroy the fleet command post. As at sea, a drone in the sky makes the perfect distraction.
campaign.ua.03.hint.site: Build the Missile site with your dozer: it launches Storm Shadow and Flamingo missiles at anything on the map.
campaign.ua.03.goal.radars: Destroy the two Pantsir radar pickets
campaign.ua.03.hint.radars: Send a Baba Yaga or riflemen to draw the Pantsirs' fire, then hit them with missiles from the Missile site.
campaign.ua.03.goal.moskva: Destroy the Black Sea Fleet command post
campaign.ua.03.hint.moskva: The command post stands on the eastern shore. A Storm Shadow is the precise weapon against buildings.
campaign.ua.04.title: Snake Island
campaign.ua.04.when: 24 February – 30 June 2022 · Zmiinyi Island, Black Sea
campaign.ua.04.video: Archive radio, first day of the war. A Russian warship calls on the 13 border guards of a rock in the sea to surrender. A pause. Then border guard Roman Hrybov's answer, transmitted for the whole world: 'Russian warship, go f*** yourself.' The guards are captured, later exchanged. The phrase becomes a postage stamp; queues around the block at the post office. Months later: Ukrainian Bohdana howitzers and HIMARS rockets pound the island, a Harpoon sinks the tug Vasily Bekh. The garrison leaves on 30 June, calling it 'a gesture of goodwill'. On 7 July a Ukrainian flag goes up on the rock.
campaign.ua.04.briefing: Russia uses Snake Island as an unsinkable air-defence platform that controls the sea lanes to Odesa and the grain ships. Their Tor and Pantsir systems cover the island and the garrison is dug in. Build HIMARS launchers, knock out the air-defence systems, and make the island impossible to hold. When the last of them is gone, plant the flag.
campaign.ua.04.hint.himars: HIMARS are built at the Vehicle factory; they fire long-range rockets at what you order them to attack.
campaign.ua.04.goal.airDefense: Destroy the island's two air-defence systems
campaign.ua.04.hint.airDefense: The Pantsirs stand on the east shore. Keep your HIMARS out of the garrison's reach and fire from a distance.
campaign.ua.04.hint.victory: The air cover is gone. Finish the garrison and its bunkers.
campaign.ua.05.title: Kharkiv Lightning
campaign.ua.05.when: 6–12 September 2022 · Balakliia, Izium and Kupiansk, Kharkiv Oblast
campaign.ua.05.video: For weeks the world has been watching Kherson in the south, where Ukraine has been loudly promising a counteroffensive. In the north, under radio silence, armour gathers in the sunflower fields. A lieutenant chalks a single word on a Bradley: KUPIANSK. Dawn on 6 September: columns race down empty roads. Abandoned T-72s, uniforms in the mud, a Russian tank turned around in a ditch. Villagers come out with bread and flags. In Izium, an hour of silence: a forest of crosses in the pines.
campaign.ua.05.briefing: The south was the feint; the real blow is here. Russian lines around Kharkiv are thin, stretched to reinforce Kherson. Their supply runs through three hubs: Balakliia, Izium and Kupiansk. Take them one by one at full speed and the whole front collapses. Do not stop to dig in: speed is our armour.
campaign.ua.05.goal.balakliia: Destroy the supply hub at Balakliia
campaign.ua.05.hint.balakliia: Balakliia is north-east across the upper ford. Lead with the Leopards, keep the Bradleys and infantry right behind.
campaign.ua.05.goal.izium: Destroy the supply hub at Izium
campaign.ua.05.goal.kupiansk: Destroy the supply hub at Kupiansk
campaign.ua.06.title: Andromeda
campaign.ua.06.video: Seismographs in Sweden twitch at 02:03. Hours later, the surface of the Baltic near Bornholm boils: a circle of gas a kilometre wide. Three of the four Nord Stream pipelines, Russia's gas lever over Europe, are ruptured. Cut to a rented sailing yacht, the Andromeda, leaving a German marina with six people and diving gear. Archive headlines over the years: governments accuse each other; German investigators follow the yacht; in August 2025 a Ukrainian suspect is arrested in Italy. Kyiv denies any state role. In this story, we follow the divers.
campaign.ua.06.briefing: This is a fictionalised version of one of the war's great mysteries. A small team, no base, no backup. The pipeline's three coastal stations carry Russian gas, and Moscow's leverage, into Europe. Destroy all three, then hold the extraction point until the boat is ready. You have a handful of riflemen, two Stugna teams and a Ratel robot: there are no reinforcements, so every man counts.
campaign.ua.06.hint.lines: The stations stand north, east and south-east of the landing. The Ratel robot breaks buildings; the Stugna teams deal with the scout car.
campaign.ua.06.hint.exfil: Pull everyone back to your safe house and hold until the boat comes.
campaign.ua.07.title: Into Kursk
campaign.ua.07.video: Montage, 2022–2024. Kherson liberated in November 2022: a man hugs a soldier in the square. The 2023 counteroffensive grinds into minefields near Robotyne. In June 2023 Wagner's columns turn around a few hours from Moscow; two months later Prigozhin's plane falls from the sky. Avdiivka is lost in February 2024. Then, on 6 August 2024, Ukrainian armour crosses the border into Russia itself. Russian conscripts surrender in a field. A Ukrainian soldier poses under the sign 'Sudzha' at the gas metering station, the last point where Russian gas still flowed to Europe.
campaign.ua.07.briefing: For two years the war has been fought on our soil. Today we take it to theirs. The border at Kursk is held by conscripts and border guards: break through three posts, take Sudzha and its gas station, then hold against the counterattack. Moscow will have to pull troops away from Donbas to throw us out, and the world will see that Russia's border is not a red line.
campaign.ua.07.goal.border: Break through the three border posts
campaign.ua.07.hint.border: The posts line the far side of the river ford. Scouts first, Bradleys behind, and the FPV team on anything armoured.
campaign.ua.07.goal.sudzha: Take Sudzha: destroy the gas station and its garrison
campaign.ua.07.hint.sudzha: Sudzha lies past the eastern woods. Destroy the gas metering station and the garrison barracks.
campaign.ua.07.hint.hold: Russian reserves are coming. Dig in around Sudzha and keep your base safe.
campaign.ua.08.title: Spiderweb
campaign.ua.08.when: 1 June 2025 · Olenya and Belaya air bases, Russia
campaign.ua.08.video: Eighteen months earlier. A warehouse in Chelyabinsk, deep in Russia. Men build wooden cabins, the kind you see on the back of trucks across the country. Under each roof: racks of small FPV quadcopters. Hired drivers, who know nothing, haul the cabins across Russia and park near air bases from Murmansk to Irkutsk, over 4,000 km from the front. 1 June 2025: the roofs slide open by remote command. A swarm rises. Satellite images: strategic bombers that fire cruise missiles at Ukrainian cities burning on their hardstands.
campaign.ua.08.briefing: Operation Spiderweb. 117 drones, hidden in trucks, are parked outside Russia's strategic bomber bases. These are the aircraft that launch the missiles killing our people every night. Your FPV teams are in position next to two airfields. Destroy the parked bombers before they can take off, then the airfields themselves. There is a jammer guarding the bases: stay out of its reach or lose your drones.
campaign.ua.08.hint.bombers: Your FPV teams launch on their own at targets in range: walk them towards the parked aircraft. Keep away from the Pole-21 jammer in the middle.
campaign.ua.08.goal.airfields: Destroy the Olenya and Belaya airfields
campaign.ua.08.hint.airfields: The bombers are burning. Now the airfields: one north, one south.
campaign.ua.09.title: The Long Arm
campaign.ua.09.when: 2024–2026 · Refineries and warehouses deep inside Russia
campaign.ua.09.video: Night, over a Russian oil refinery 1,000 km from the border: the buzz of a Lyutyi drone, then a fireball. Montage of flames at Ryazan, Kirishi, Volgograd; queues at Russian petrol stations in summer 2025. August 2025: a long red cruise missile, the Flamingo, rolls out of a Ukrainian factory. Summer 2026: the targets change. Warehouses of Wildberries, Russia's biggest online retailer, which Kyiv says store drone parts, burn in Penza, Tula, Tambov, Yekaterinburg, more than 2,000 km away. In Tambov, night-shift workers die. The war has no rear any more.
campaign.ua.09.briefing: Russia's war runs on fuel, money and parts bought abroad and shipped through its warehouses. We cannot match their artillery shell for shell, but we can reach their economy. Build a missile site, burn three refineries, then the two warehouses that feed their drone factories. Their Shaheds will answer: keep your air defences ready.
campaign.ua.09.hint.site: Build the Missile site: Flamingo missiles reach anywhere on the map. Build a Drone workshop for Baba Yaga bombers too.
campaign.ua.09.hint.refineries: The refineries are far to the north-east, south-east and east, each one with its own guard. Flamingos are inaccurate: send several.
campaign.ua.09.hint.warehouses: The warehouses stand east of the river, north and south of their base.
campaign.ua.10.title: The Bunker
campaign.ua.10.video: From here the story is ours, not the news. Snow over the Kremlin. In a bunker deep below, a man watches maps that no longer match the front. Generals avoid his eyes. Cut to the Ukrainian lines: Leopards, HIMARS, a Patriot battery, and soldiers who have been fighting since Hostomel. One of them, the conscript who dropped his tea on the first morning, now a sergeant, checks his rifle. The radio crackles: 'All units. Red Line. Go.'
campaign.ua.10.briefing: Commander, this is the last mission. Putin has withdrawn to the command bunker beneath the Kremlin, protected by a ring of Pantsir air-defence systems and the best units he has left. While he lives, the missiles will keep falling on our cities. Break the Pantsir shield, destroy the bunker, and the war ends with him. Then make sure nothing is left that can start it again.
campaign.ua.10.goal.shield: Break the Pantsir shield around the Kremlin
campaign.ua.10.hint.shield: The Kremlin stands south-west of the Russian base, ringed by three Pantsirs and bunkers. HIMARS outrange them; the Patriot guards your base against their Su-34s.
campaign.ua.10.hint.bunker: The shield is down. A Storm Shadow or the HIMARS can now reach the command bunker.
campaign.ua.ending: Silence over Moscow. The bunker's ventilation shafts smoke in the snow. On state television, the anchor reads a short statement, then the screen goes to test pattern. Montage: Russian soldiers walking home along a road in Zaporizhzhia; a train arriving at Kyiv station full of returning families; children painting a giant An-225 on a wall in Hostomel; a diver laying a wreath over the wreck of the Moskva; on Snake Island, a border guard raising the flag again. The sergeant from the first mission sits on the steps of Antonov Airport and finally drinks his tea. Text: THE END. Slava Ukraini.
campaign.ru.01.title: Hostomel
campaign.ru.01.when: 24 February 2022 · Antonov Airport, Hostomel, north-west of Kyiv
campaign.ru.01.video: Black screen. A voice on state television announces a 'special military operation'. Dawn over Belarus: rows of Il-76 transports with their engines running, paratroopers in blue berets climbing aboard. Low over the Kyiv Reservoir, helicopters in tight formation, a Ka-52 gunship leading. The airport comes into view. A flare, a missile trail, a Mi-8 falls away. The rest flare and land. Doors open. Title: MODERN CONQUEST: RED LINE — RUSSIA.
campaign.ru.01.briefing: The plan, Commander, is speed. Kyiv must fall in days. Our VDV assault group has landed at the Antonov airport in Hostomel. Destroy its defenders, then hold the runway so that the Il-76 transports can land with the main force. In the real war, Ukrainian artillery cratered this runway and the airlift never came. Today we write a different story.
campaign.ru.01.goal.airport: Take the airport: destroy its two watch posts and the hangar
campaign.ru.01.hint.airport: The airport defences are west of the landing zone. Lead with the BMDs, keep the RPG gunners behind them.
campaign.ru.01.goal.hold: Hold the runway until the Il-76s land ({time})
campaign.ru.01.hint.hold: The Ukrainian National Guard is counterattacking from the west. Hold around your command post and train more paratroopers at the Barracks.
campaign.ru.02.title: Snake Island
campaign.ru.02.video: Black Sea, first day. The cruiser Moskva, flagship of the fleet, cuts through grey water with the patrol ship Vasily Bykov at her side. On the bridge, an officer takes the radio and calls on the island garrison to surrender or be destroyed. The island answers with an insult heard around the world. The officer shrugs, and the guns turn.
campaign.ru.02.briefing: Zmiinyi is a rock 35 km off the coast, but whoever holds it controls the sea lanes to Odesa. The garrison has refused to surrender. Our landing group has heavy support: TOS-1A thermobaric launchers and BMPs. Destroy the two guard posts, then the border post itself. The fleet will remember this island; in April it will lose its flagship to Ukrainian missiles, and in June Russia will leave the rock. Not in this story.
campaign.ru.02.hint.guards: The posts cover the island's west. Fire the TOS-1A from range, then send the infantry in behind the BMPs.
campaign.ru.03.title: Azovstal
campaign.ru.03.video: From the air: Mariupol, a port city of 400,000 on the Sea of Azov, burning under a grey sky. Block after block of ruined apartment buildings. Our troops advance street by street. In the east of the city, the vast Azovstal steelworks, built in Soviet times with tunnels and bunkers meant to survive a nuclear war. Its last defenders are underground, and they will not come out. On 20 May 2022 the last of them, more than 2,400 men, will lay down their arms.
campaign.ru.03.briefing: The city is ours except for the steelworks. Its defenders have turned Azovstal into a fortress: bunkers outside, command post and workshops inside. Bring up a TOS-1A to burn out the bunkers, then destroy the steelworks and the command post. The land corridor to Crimea depends on this city.
campaign.ru.03.hint.tos: Build a TOS-1A at the Vehicle factory: its thermobaric rockets crush infantry and bunkers from range.
campaign.ru.03.goal.bunkers: Destroy the two bunkers in front of Azovstal
campaign.ru.03.hint.bunkers: The bunkers stand east of the steelworks, facing you. Fire the TOS-1A at them from out of range of their guns.
campaign.ru.03.goal.azovstal: Destroy the Azovstal steelworks and its command post
campaign.ru.03.hint.azovstal: The steelworks are in the far west of the town, next to the command post.
campaign.ru.04.title: Meat Grinder
campaign.ru.04.video: A prison yard, summer 2022. A bald man in a leather jacket steps out of a helicopter: Yevgeny Prigozhin, owner of the Wagner company. 'Six months at the front and you go home free. Desert, and you are shot.' Winter in Bakhmut: assault teams of former convicts walk forward through the snow, wave after wave. May 2023: Prigozhin stands among rows of bodies and screams at the camera at Shoigu and Gerasimov: 'Where are the shells?' On 20 May he plants the Wagner flag on the ruins.
campaign.ru.04.briefing: Bakhmut has become a symbol for both sides. Wagner storms it in small assault detachments, at any cost. Raise twelve assault riflemen, break the three strongpoints on the western road, then take the town centre. Ammunition is short; men, for now, are not.
campaign.ru.04.hint.wagner: Train riflemen at the Barracks. Wagner fought in small groups: send them in fours behind cover.
campaign.ru.04.goal.strongpoints: Destroy the three strongpoints in front of Bakhmut
campaign.ru.04.hint.strongpoints: The strongpoints line the west bank, across the fords. RPG gunners break them; riflemen handle the defenders.
campaign.ru.04.goal.town: Take the town: destroy the Artemivsk barracks
campaign.ru.05.title: The Surovikin Line
campaign.ru.05.video: Drone footage, 8 June 2023: a column of brand-new Leopard 2 tanks and Bradleys crawls through a minefield near Mala Tokmachka. One stops, smoking, then another. The 'Surovikin line', layers of trenches, dragon's teeth and mines dug all winter, is holding. Two weeks later, 24 June: Wagner columns seize the army headquarters in Rostov and roll north on the highway to Moscow. Helicopters are shot down. Then, 200 km from the capital, the column stops: Lukashenko has brokered a deal. In August, Prigozhin's private jet falls out of the sky near Tver.
campaign.ru.05.briefing: Ukraine's great counteroffensive is here, with Western tanks. And as it hits our lines, Wagner is marching on Moscow and the whole army is looking over its shoulder. Hold the line, whatever happens in the capital. The Leopard and Bradley spearhead is aiming at our headquarters. Survive their assault, then destroy every tank of the spearhead.
campaign.ru.05.hint.hold: Keep the RPG gunners behind the bunkers and the T-72s in reserve. Build more defences with the dozer.
campaign.ru.05.goal.spearhead: Destroy the four Leopards and four Bradleys of the spearhead
campaign.ru.05.hint.spearhead: The spearhead is breaking. Counterattack and finish every Leopard and Bradley.
campaign.ru.06.title: Glide Bombs
campaign.ru.06.video: A Su-34 bomber pulls up 70 km from the front and releases a FAB-1500, a 1.5-tonne Soviet bomb fitted with cheap wings and satellite guidance. It glides for minutes, silent. A Ukrainian strongpoint at the Avdiivka coke plant disappears in a column of dust. Night after night. In October 2023 assault groups crawl through drainage pipes towards the town. On 17 February 2024 Ukraine pulls out of Avdiivka.
campaign.ru.06.briefing: Avdiivka has been a fortress since 2014, with the giant Koksokhim coke plant on the north side and the Zenit strongpoint to the south. We will not storm it head-on. Build two Su-34s and let the glide bombs do the work. Watch out for their Gepards.
campaign.ru.06.hint.su34: Build Su-34 bombers at the Airfield. They drop glide bombs from beyond the range of the Gepard and return to reload.
campaign.ru.06.hint.koksokhim: The plant stands in the far north-west. Order the Su-34s to attack it; send them in pairs.
campaign.ru.07.title: The Pipe
campaign.ru.07.video: August 2024: Ukrainian armour crosses the border into Kursk and takes Sudzha. Months of counterattacks follow, with North Korean soldiers fighting alongside ours in the snow. Then a plan out of a war novel. An old gas pipeline, the Urengoy–Pomary–Uzhhorod, empty since Ukraine stopped transit on 1 January 2025, runs right under the Ukrainian lines into Sudzha. Hundreds of men crawl into it with oxygen masks, and walk 15 km in the dark for days. On 8 March they climb out behind the enemy.
campaign.ru.07.briefing: Operation Stream. Our assault troops have come out of the pipeline right behind the Ukrainian positions at Sudzha. They are exhausted and short of supplies, but the enemy is looking the other way. Destroy the two trench lines, take the Sudzha command post, and hold until the main force links up.
campaign.ru.07.goal.trenches: Destroy the two trench strongpoints at Sudzha
campaign.ru.07.hint.trenches: You came out west of the strongpoints, behind the enemy. Attack them from the rear before the Bradleys turn around.
campaign.ru.07.hint.sudzha: The command post is just west of the trenches. RPG gunners first.
campaign.ru.07.goal.hold: Hold Sudzha until the main force arrives ({time})
campaign.ru.07.hint.hold: Ukrainian reserves are coming from the west. Hold around Sudzha and send reinforcements from your base.
campaign.ru.08.title: Oreshnik
campaign.ru.08.video: Night over Dnipro. Six bright points fall from the sky, each splitting into a shower of glowing projectiles: a new intermediate-range ballistic missile, the Oreshnik, used for the first time against the Yuzhmash rocket factory. The next day, Putin on television: it cannot be intercepted. Montage, 2025: Shahed drones, which we call Geran, launched by hundreds every night; one night in September more than 800. Ukrainian air defenders, exhausted, count missiles on their screens.
campaign.ru.08.briefing: Yuzhmash in Dnipro builds Ukraine's missiles, and two Patriot batteries protect it. We will saturate them: launch waves of Geran-2 drones until their interceptors run dry, then strike the factory. The Oreshnik showed what we can do; your Gerans will show they cannot stop all of it.
campaign.ru.08.hint.gerans: Build Geran-2 drones at the Geran launch site. They wait on their rails until you give them a target.
campaign.ru.08.hint.patriots: The Patriots stand by the factory in the north-west. Send all the Gerans at once: a wave saturates the Sting nest and the Gepard.
campaign.ru.08.hint.yuzhmash: The sky is open. Use the Su-34 from the Airfield or the next Geran wave against the factory.
campaign.ru.09.title: Bankova
campaign.ru.09.video: From here the story is ours, not the news. A different winter: the front breaks. Columns roll past Brovary at dawn, through suburbs of empty high-rises. On the right bank, the golden domes of the Lavra and, behind them, the government quarter on Bankova Street: the presidential office, sandbags in its windows, a Patriot battery in a park nearby.
campaign.ru.09.briefing: Commander, the road to Kyiv is open at last. The government quarter on Bankova Street is defended by a Patriot battery and the last Leopards. Take out the Patriot, destroy the presidential office and break their resistance. With Kyiv gone, the rest of the old Union will listen.
campaign.ru.09.hint.patriot: The Patriot stands north of Bankova, across the river. Use the TOS-1A and tanks; do not send aircraft until it is gone.
campaign.ru.09.goal.bankova: Destroy the presidential office on Bankova
campaign.ru.09.hint.bankova: Bankova is in the middle of the western city. Build a base: you will need more than this column.
campaign.ru.10.title: Narva
campaign.ru.10.when: Alternate history · Narva river, Estonian border
campaign.ru.10.video: Months later. In this story, Moldova and Georgia have been pulled back into Moscow's orbit, and Belarus is part of the Union State. On the Narva river two medieval castles face each other across the water: Ivangorod on our side, Narva Castle on theirs. On the far bank, the volunteers of the last coalition of former republics, armed with Western kit: Bradleys, Patriots, Leopards. A border sign: 'European Union'.
campaign.ru.10.briefing: This is the last border of the old Union. The coalition holds the bridgeheads on the far bank of the Narva and its headquarters behind them. Cross the river, destroy both bridgeheads and the coalition headquarters. When this bank falls, the map of 1991 will be redrawn.
campaign.ru.10.goal.bridgeheads: Destroy the two bridgeheads on the far bank
campaign.ru.10.hint.bridgeheads: The bridgeheads guard the north and south bridges. Cross at the centre with the tanks while the infantry holds the bridges.
campaign.ru.ending: A victory parade on Red Square. The camera rises over columns of tanks, then over a huge map unrolled on the cobbles: the borders of 1991, all in red. Then the cut: a mother in a village near Pskov looking at a photograph; a field of fresh graves stretching to the horizon; empty classrooms in Mariupol; a young soldier from the first mission, now grey, staring at the river at Narva. The music fades. Text: THE END. The map is red again. Count what it cost.
